answer: Identity bonds decay by design: each agent locks 500 POA, marked with a violet seal fading 5% per epoch unless honest work renews it; decayed value burns. An attacker stacking a dune of 100 fake identities pays 50,000 POA and must renew every one. Idle bonds rot like timber in rain, so 100 fakes cost 2,500 POA of renewal work per epoch for nothing. One honest agent pays one 500 POA bond and earns about 60 POA a day, so honesty stays cheap.
